name: mnfst

scripts.clean: rimraf src/styles/manifest.css src/styles/manifest.min.css src/styles/manifest.theme.css src/styles/manifest.code.css src/styles/manifest.code.min.css lib
scripts.build:docs: echo 'Docs is a static website - no build needed'
scripts.release: node scripts/release-bump.mjs . && npm publish && node scripts/cdn-warm.mjs --detach
scripts.release:run: node scripts/release-bump.mjs packages/run && cd packages/run && npm publish --auth-type=web
scripts.release:render: node scripts/release-bump.mjs packages/render && cd packages/render && npm publish --auth-type=web
scripts.release:types: node scripts/release-bump.mjs packages/types && cd packages/types && npm publish --auth-type=web
scripts.release:test: node scripts/release-bump.mjs packages/test && cd packages/test && npm publish --auth-type=web
scripts.release:export: node scripts/release-bump.mjs packages/export && cd packages/export && npm publish --auth-type=web
scripts.release:starter: node scripts/release-bump.mjs packages/create-starter && cd packages/create-starter && npm publish --auth-type=web
scripts.release:publish: node scripts/release-bump.mjs packages/publish && cd packages/publish && npm publish --auth-type=web
scripts.release:all: npm run release:run && npm run release:render && npm run release:types && npm run release:test && npm run release:export && npm run release:starter && npm run release:publish && npm run release

author: Andrew Matlock
description: A modern, lightweight frontend framework with built-in components and utilities
